fillPolicy.distance: four-neighbour path through covered posts to an original stereo match

metadata.provenance: Original main.js generate() executes with Three.js; spire meshes are removed before the original buildHeightmap() samples the scene; original dtm-worker samples the reference and produce-worker runs stereo acquisition. The export reapplies original filling from stereo matches with an explicit 4 m eligibility limit. Origins follow actual bounded match/fill records.
metadata.scope: Generated terrain mesh, ordinary boulders, pebbles and detail normal field; spires explicitly excluded before heightmap generation. Rover, decorative base, UI and original material styling are omitted from the scientific preview. This is simulated terrain, not measured lunar data.
metadata.coordinates: Exported scene positions are east, height, south in metres. Add sceneToLocalHeight_m to scene height; subtract localDatum_m from ideal and delivered heights. Plot north = -south. No independent rescaling or vertical fitting.
